title: Milk River Pipeline (Inter Pipeline) - the CER border trunkline
dek: One short trunkline, two names in the house record, and no gathering system behind the name: the Inter Pipeline system acquired from Plains in 2021 IS the CER-regulated Milk River pipeline (balance-model key milk_river). It takes Bow River barrels at the Milk River interconnect and delivers them to the Front Range Pipeline at the border west of Coutts. The gathering that feeds it is a different Inter Pipeline system, Bow River.
